newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda higher on earnings forecast revision.
newsitem.headline: Honda higher on earnings forecast revision.

text.p: Honda Motor Co shares were higher in early Monday morning trade, lifted by the company's upward revision of its earnings forecast for the six months to September 30 announced on Friday, brokers said.
As of 0034 GMT, the shares were 40 yen higher at 2,580 yen, with turnover of 856,000.
On Friday Honda, one of Japan's leading car and motorcycle manufacturers, said it was revising its half-year parent current profit forecast up to 60.00 billion yen from 45.00 billion yen.
